ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with a low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels, limited primarily to localized scarring and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across both lobes (X:0-100, Y:0-100 coordinate space) with no macro-level white mottling; focal high-intensity points mapped primarily to distal tips and scattered linear disruptions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle (estimated 55-65 degrees) and deep pixel-depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with low-to-mid amplitude peaks; right lobe trailing edge exhibits more pronounced jaggedness compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a complex curve, starting concave near the median notch and transitioning to convex as the trajectory approaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixels (tan/white) localized on the extreme left and right distal tips, identifying barnacle colonies.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of non-aligned, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated in the mid-left and lower-right quadrants of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips and prominent multi-directional linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced accumulation of calcified material at the lobe tips creating a visually distinct, high-relief texture relative to the smooth fluke surface.
